_comment: NOT APPLIED on pmaxhogan/fritzkit (2026-10-31): the code_coverage rule needs GitHub Code Quality, which is GA on GitHub Team and Enterprise Cloud only; a personal-account repo has no Code quality settings page, so the rule can never evaluate. It was created, verified inert and removed again. The stack fallback (coverage/compare-job, .github/workflows/coverage.yml, required check "coverage" in the main ruleset) is the enforced ratchet. Re-apply this body with POST /repos/pmaxhogan/fritzkit/rulesets if the account ever moves to a plan with Code Quality.
